actions.description: Bookmark a tweet for an authenticated user.
actions.name: bookmark-tweet

userId.description: The ID of the authenticated source User for whom to add bookmarks. Example: "2244994945"

tweetId.description: The ID of the Tweet to bookmark. Example: "1460323737035677698"

actions.description: Create a liked tweet in Twitter/X
actions.name: create-liked-tweet

userId.description: The ID of the authenticated user that is requesting to like the Post. Must match the authenticated user.

tweetId.description: The ID of the Post to like. Example: "1228393702244134912"

actions.description: Create a list in Twitter/X
actions.name: create-list

name.description: Name of the list. Example: "Tech News"

description.description: Description for the list. Example: "Top tech journalists and publications"

private.description: Whether the list is private. If true, only the owner can view the list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the created list.

actions.description: Create a tweet in Twitter/X.
actions.name: create-tweet

text.description: The text content of the tweet. Maximum 280 characters.

replyToTweetId.description: The ID of the tweet to reply to. If provided, creates a reply tweet.

quoteTweetId.description: The ID of the tweet to quote. If provided, creates a quote tweet.

mediaIds.description: Media IDs for media attachments to include in the tweet (from the upload endpoint).

id.description: The unique identifier of the created tweet.

text.description: The text content of the created tweet.

actions.description: Remove a liked tweet (unlike) for the authenticated user.
actions.name: delete-liked-tweet

tweet_id.description: The ID of the liked tweet to remove. Example: "1346889436626259968"

actions.description: Delete a List owned by the authenticated user
actions.name: delete-list

id.description: The ID of the List to delete. Example: "1234567890"

actions.description: Delete or archive a tweet in Twitter/X
actions.name: delete-tweet

id.description: The ID of the tweet to be deleted. Example: "1346889436626259968"

actions.description: Follow a user from the authenticated account.
actions.name: follow-user

target_user_id.description: The user ID of the user to follow. Example: "2244994945"

pending_follow.description: Whether the follow is pending (target user has protected account and must accept the request)

actions.description: Retrieve a single liked tweet from Twitter/X by its ID.
actions.name: get-liked-tweet

tweet_id.description: The unique identifier of the tweet to retrieve. Example: "1346889436626259968"

id.description: The unique identifier of this tweet. Example: "1346889436626259968"

text.description: The content of the tweet. Example: "Learn how to use the user Tweet timeline..."

author_id.description: The unique identifier of the author of this tweet.

created_at.description: Creation time of the tweet. Format: ISO 8601 date-time.

lang.description: Language of the tweet, if detected by X.

possibly_sensitive.description: Indicates if the tweet contains URLs marked as sensitive.

reply_settings.description: Shows who can reply to this tweet.

conversation_id.description: The conversation ID for the tweet.

in_reply_to_user_id.description: If this tweet is a reply, the ID of the user it is replying to.

referenced_tweets.description: A list of tweets this tweet refers to (retweets, quotes, replies).

actions.description: Retrieve a single list from Twitter/X
actions.name: get-list

id.description: The ID of the List to lookup. Example: "1355797419175383040"

actions.description: Retrieve a single mention from Twitter/X.
actions.name: get-mention

id.description: The unique identifier of the Tweet to retrieve. Example: "1234567890"

actions.description: Retrieve a single space from Twitter/X
actions.name: get-space

space_id.description: The unique identifier of the Space to retrieve. Example: "1zqKVXPQhvZJB"

actions.description: Retrieve a single tweet from Twitter/X.
actions.name: get-tweet

id.description: The unique identifier of the Tweet to retrieve. Example: "1050118621198921728"

actions.description: Retrieve a single user from Twitter/X
actions.name: get-user

id.description: The ID of the User to lookup. Example: "2244994945"

actions.description: Like a tweet
actions.name: like-tweet

tweetId.description: The ID of the tweet to like. Example: "1346889436626259968"

liked.description: Whether the tweet was successfully liked

actions.description: List liked tweets from a specific Twitter/X user
actions.name: list-liked-tweets

userId.description: The ID of the User to lookup liked tweets for. Example: "2244994945"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor token for the next page of results. Omit for the first page.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of results per page (5-100). Default: 100.

nextCursor.description: Token for the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages.

previousCursor.description: Token for the previous page of results.

resultCount.description: Number of results returned in this response.

actions.description: List all Lists owned by a specified user from X API
actions.name: list-lists

userId.description: The user ID whose owned Lists you would like to retrieve. Example: "123456789"

maxResults.description: The maximum number of results to be returned per page. This can be a number between 1 and 100. Default: 100

paginationToken.description: Pagination token from the previous response to get the next page of results

actions.description: List mentions from Twitter/X for a specified user.
actions.name: list-mentions

user_id.description: The user ID whose mentions to retrieve. Example: "2244994945"

cursor.description: Pagination token from the previous response (meta.next_token). Omit for the first page.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results per page (5-100). Default: 10.

start_time.description: Earliest UTC timestamp from which Tweets will be provided (ISO 8601). Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z".

end_time.description: Latest UTC timestamp to which Tweets will be provided (ISO 8601). Example: "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z".

since_id.description: Minimum Tweet ID to be included in the result set. Takes precedence over start_time.

until_id.description: Maximum Tweet ID to be included in the result set. Takes precedence over end_time.

exclude.description: Types of Tweets to exclude from results.

tweet_fields.description: Comma-separated list of Tweet fields to return. Example: "created_at,public_metrics,author_id".

expansions.description: Comma-separated list of fields to expand. Example: "author_id,referenced_tweets.id".

user_fields.description: Comma-separated list of User fields to return for expanded users. Example: "username,verified,public_metrics".

media_fields.description: Comma-separated list of Media fields to return.

place_fields.description: Comma-separated list of Place fields to return.

poll_fields.description: Comma-separated list of Poll fields to return.

actions.description: List Spaces from Twitter/X matching a search query
actions.name: list-spaces

query.description: Search term to filter Spaces by title. Example: "crypto"

state.description: Filter by Space state: live, scheduled, or all. Default: all

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 100

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response for fetching next page

actions.description: List tweets from a specific Twitter/X user timeline.
actions.name: list-tweets

user_id.description: The ID of the User whose tweets to retrieve. Example: "2244994945"

max_results.description: Maximum number of results per page (5-100).

pagination_token.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page of results.

since_id.description: Minimum tweet ID to include in the result set.

until_id.description: Maximum tweet ID to include in the result set.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Earliest UTC timestamp from which tweets will be provided.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Latest UTC timestamp to which tweets will be provided.

exclude.description: Entities to exclude from results (replies or retweets).

actions.description: List users from Twitter/X by IDs or usernames
actions.name: list-users

ids.description: List of user IDs to look up. Up to 100 IDs can be provided. Example: ["2244994945", "783214"]

usernames.description: List of usernames to look up. Up to 100 usernames can be provided. Example: ["XDevelopers", "X"]

userFields.description: Additional user fields to include in the response. Example: ["created_at", "description", "public_metrics", "verified", "location", "profile_image_url"]

expansions.description: Expansions to include in the response. Example: ["pinned_tweet_id"]

actions.description: Remove a tweet bookmark
actions.name: remove-bookmark

tweet_id.description: The ID of the tweet to remove from bookmarks. Example: "1234567890"

bookmark_removed.description: Whether the bookmark was successfully removed

tweet_id.description: The ID of the tweet that was removed from bookmarks

actions.description: Unfollow a user from the authenticated account
actions.name: unfollow-user

target_user_id.description: The user ID of the user to unfollow. Example: "123456789"

actions.description: Unlike a Tweet
actions.name: unlike-tweet

tweet_id.description: The unique identifier of the Tweet to unlike. Example: "1234567890123456789"

actions.description: Update a list in Twitter/X.
actions.name: update-list

id.description: The ID of the List to modify. Example: "1146654567674912769"

name.description: The name of the List. Example: "test v2 update list"

description.description: The description of the List. Example: "example update"

private.description: Determines whether the List should be private.

syncs.description: Sync spaces from Twitter/X using the search endpoint
syncs.name: spaces

syncs.description: Sync tweets from Twitter/X user timeline
syncs.name: tweets
